_meta.what: Categories RamHub adds to a club on top of the ones RamCentral gives it. Keyed by the club's slug.
_meta.whose: RamHub's own grouping — an editorial call by this project, NOT data from RamCentral or the college. Everything else about a club is imported as published; this file is the one place we add something.
_meta.why: RamCentral has no technology category, so the computing and engineering clubs were scattered across Academic, Special Interest, or nowhere at all.
_meta.Technology: Computing, AI, robotics, and the engineering-technology clubs. Each entry was checked against the club's own name or description on RamCentral. ColorStack at FSC published no description; it is listed on the strength of ColorStack being a national community for computer science students.
_meta.editing: Add a slug to put a club in a category; it is applied on the next `manage.py import_clubs`. A test fails if a slug here is not in the export, so a renamed or deleted club cannot leave a dead entry behind.
